name: play-upload
summary: Validate inputs and opt in to uploading a built Android App Bundle to Google Play from the publish workflow.

variables.PLAY_UPLOAD_ENABLED: Set to "true" to allow the upload step to run. Any other value (or unset) keeps uploads disabled.
variables.ANDROID_PACKAGE_NAME: The Android application id/package name to publish, for example com.example.app.
variables.PLAY_STORE_TRACK: The Google Play track to publish to, for example internal, alpha, beta, or production.

patches.change: After a successful AAB build, add a guarded upload step that runs only when vars.PLAY_UPLOAD_ENABLED == 'true'. Run scripts/check-play-upload.mjs with ANDROID_PACKAGE_NAME, PLAY_STORE_TRACK, AAB_PATH, PLAY_UPLOAD_ENABLED and PLAY_PUBLISHER_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON, then call r0adkll/upload-google-play (or your chosen uploader) with the same values. Keep the workflow_call-only trigger and keep all credentials in _publish.yml. See the README for the exact YAML.
